experimental_unit: one fixed query with its fixed ordered 50-candidate pool served through one declared reranker route; persistent resource replication is one complete fresh worker lifetime

controlled_variables.model_revision_and_file_hashes: revision 233902d25c440f23af6f7d6e94d2946bac0bee0a; full file SHA-256 digest list recorded in protocol.md section 7
controlled_variables.sigmoid_normalisation: shared production sigmoid contract; production SentenceTransformerReranker used unmodified for Torch cells
controlled_variables.target_host: Apple Silicon macOS with at least 16 GiB physical memory
controlled_variables.machine_policy: same physical machine, macOS build, power source and registered background-load/thermal policy; no vector DB, embedding, BM25, document parsing or network access inside measured inference
controlled_variables.w1_parent_state: fallback-ready parent with ONNX loaded and warmed before paired measured rows; identical state retained for W3 fallback measurement
controlled_variables.warmup_policy: untimed model load and warm-up recorded separately and excluded from aggregates
controlled_variables.memory_growth_estimator: Theil-Sen slope in MiB per 1,000 requests with seeded block-bootstrap one-sided 95% upper confidence bound
controlled_variables.growth_window_sampling: after every completed request inside requests 201-1000 (at least 800 ordered samples per lifetime)
controlled_variables.whole_lifetime_counterbalance_schedule: seed 20260821; three blocks, each a rotation by +2 of the seeded shuffle [W5, W3, W2, W4, W1]; exact table in protocol.md section 15
controlled_variables.thermal_and_interference_abort_policy: mains power required; complete lifetime invalid when host thermal pressure exceeds nominal or a declared foreground interference occurs; invalidation repeats the complete lifetime

gate_table.name: persistent_mps_deployment_value
gate_table.interpretation: deployment comparison only; not a cross-backend correctness gate or Experiment 5 H2 replication

gate_table.name: post_burn_in_memory_growth
gate_table.aggregation_rule: every lifetime and pooled bound pass

gate_table.name: deadline_bounded_failure_fallback
gate_table.required_outcome: ONNX CPU or existing un-reranked fallback completes loudly; no late response admitted

gate_table.name: shutdown_restart_reaping_and_orphans
gate_table.drain_term_kill_idle_orphan_bounds: drain 2 s; TERM grace 5 s; KILL grace 5 s; idle expiry 60 s; orphan observation 10 s

gate_table.name: tdr_014_admissibility
gate_table.required_outcome: plan agreement, manifests, preflight, no fallback, raw rows, atomic complete-lifetime checkpoints, complete statuses and deterministic projections all pass

lifecycle_probes: worker SIGKILL during an in-flight request
worker SIGSTOP or otherwise non-responsive during an in-flight request
external parent SIGKILL while worker is idle
external parent SIGKILL while worker is in-flight
idle expiry followed by new worker generation and route preflight
orderly shutdown with bounded drain then TERM/KILL
wait/reap verification and zero orphaned descendants
abort_criteria: plan and runner cell matrices disagree
requested backend/device/provider differs from the observed effective route
model identity, tokenizer policy, workload identity or fixed request order differs
PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK was not 0 before Torch import
a Torch-stack module is imported in the parent
any measured response is unreranked, wrong-cardinality, wrong-generation, malformed or late
model download or network activity contaminates preflight or measured work
current RSS sampling is unavailable -> G5/G6 NOT_EVALUABLE and promotion blocked
thermal, power or foreground-interference policy is breached -> complete lifetime invalid
a process failure prevents a declared lifetime from completing -> incomplete, never numeric
checkpoint is partial or a statistic would cross worker PIDs/generations
raw_artefacts: reference to the immutable Experiment 5 workload and SHA-256
